POR.name: Portugal

lines.intro: Watch closely. This is how it is done.
lines.win: Siiiu! Did you see? Of course you saw.
lines.lose: Impossible. We go again, and I will score twice.

taunt: I have played in five World Cups. You have played in zero.
My free kicks have their own fan club.
Bring your best card. It is still not me.
scout: Ronaldo is their best card. He shoots from anywhere.
Bruno Fernandes pulls the strings in midfield.
POR.fact: Ronaldo has played in five World Cups — more than anyone.

QAT.name: Qatar

lines.intro: Welcome. I brought tricks. Lots of tricks.
lines.win: The tricks worked! They always work.
lines.lose: You saw the tricks, at least. Next time they end in goals.

taunt: Afif was named Asia's best player. Twice.
We won the Asian Cup with a wink and a chip.
Hope you like skill moves. We have all of them.
scout: Afif is the star — quick feet, quicker smile.
Almoez Ali scores the big goals for Qatar.
QAT.fact: Qatar hosted the 2022 World Cup and has won the Asian Cup twice.

RSA.name: South Africa

lines.intro: I am the captain AND the keeper. Good luck scoring.
lines.win: Bafana Bafana! The boys did the job and the door stayed shut.
lines.lose: You got past me. Very few do. Enjoy it.

taunt: I once saved four penalties in one shootout. Four.
My gloves are ready. Are your strikers?
Shoot all you like. I catch everything.
scout: Their captain is the goalkeeper — Williams, a penalty-stopping wall.
Teboho Mokoena hits rockets from midfield.
RSA.fact: Keeper Ronwen Williams once saved four penalties in a single shootout.

SCO.name: Scotland

lines.intro: The Tartan Army is singing. Try not to let it rattle you.
lines.win: Aye, that'll do nicely. All of Scotland heard that roar.
lines.lose: Hard luck for us, well played you. We'll be louder next time.

taunt: Our fans out-sing everyone. Even when we're losing.
McTominay scores goals now. Nobody knows how to stop it.
It's always a battle against Scotland. Bring your boots.
scout: McTominay arrives late in the box and scores.
Captain Robertson charges up the left wing all match.
SCO.fact: Scotland's fans, the Tartan Army, are famous for never stopping singing.

SEN.name: Senegal

lines.intro: We are the Lions of Teranga. We welcome you. Then we roar.
lines.win: The lions roared today. Senegal dances tonight.
lines.lose: Even lions rest. We will hunt again next match.

taunt: Mané has been Africa's best player. Twice.
Our whole team runs like the wind off the ocean.
Koulibaly has been a wall for years. Good luck.
scout: Mané is the star — fast, direct, always dangerous.
Kalidou Koulibaly leads the defence like a fortress.
SEN.fact: Senegal won their first Africa Cup of Nations in 2022 — on penalties.

SUI.name: Switzerland

lines.intro: Switzerland is precise. Like our watches. Like my passing.
lines.win: Precise. Punctual. Three points, exactly on time.
lines.lose: Even a Swiss watch skips a beat. It will not happen twice.

taunt: My passes arrive on time. To the second.
We beat the big teams when it matters. Ask around.
Climb a mountain before you face us. For practice.
scout: Xhaka controls the middle — every attack goes through him.
Keeper Gregor Kobel is one of the best around.
SUI.fact: Switzerland reached the knockout rounds at three straight World Cups.

SWE.name: Sweden

lines.intro: When I score, the mask comes on. Prepare to see the mask.
lines.win: The mask! You saw the mask. Sweden marches on.
lines.lose: No mask today. Next match it returns, I promise.

taunt: Gyökeres out-scored everyone in Europe. Then did it again.
Isak glides. Gyökeres smashes. Pick your problem.
Our strikers are faster than your defenders. Simple maths.
scout: Two big strikers: Isak the smooth one, Gyökeres the strong one.
Watch the counter-attack — Sweden breaks at full speed.
SWE.fact: Gyökeres celebrates goals with an invisible mask over his face.

TUN.name: Tunisia

lines.intro: My name is Hannibal. The Eagles of Carthage fly with me.
lines.win: The eagles soar! Carthage remembers this one.
lines.lose: Eagles circle back. We always circle back.

taunt: We beat France at the last World Cup. Look it up.
The Eagles of Carthage have sharp talons and sharper passing.
Hannibal crossed the Alps. A football pitch is easy.
scout: Hannibal Mejbri brings the energy and the tricks.
Ellyes Skhiri covers every blade of grass in midfield.
TUN.fact: Tunisia beat France 1-0 at the 2022 World Cup.

TUR.name: Türkiye

lines.intro: Give me one free kick. That is all Türkiye needs.
lines.win: Türkiye celebrates! The crescent and star shine tonight.
lines.lose: You dodged my free kicks today. You cannot dodge them forever.

taunt: Arda Güler is called the Little Prince. Wait until he is king.
My shots bend around walls. Build a bigger wall.
Our fans make more noise than a rocket launch.
scout: Çalhanoğlu's long shots are the danger. Stand off him and pay.
Young Arda Güler can unlock any defence with one pass.
TUR.fact: Türkiye's young star Arda Güler is nicknamed the Little Prince.

URU.name: Uruguay

lines.intro: I play fair. Mostly. Define fair.
lines.win: Told you it was fair. The scoreboard agrees with me.
lines.lose: Fine. That was fair too. Barely.

taunt: I score with my feet, my head, and... mostly my feet.
Uruguay has won two World Cups. How many has your shop won?
Valverde's shots could dent a bus.
scout: Suárez sometimes uses his hand — the ref spots it every time.
Valverde hits thunderbolts from midfield.
URU.fact: Uruguay won the very first World Cup in 1930 — at home.

USA.name: United States

lines.intro: Captain America reporting. Caruso is here too. He hustles.
lines.win: USA! USA! That one is for the home fans.
lines.lose: We will sprint it back. That is the American way.

taunt: It is called soccer here, and we are getting scary good at it.
Caruso will chase you down. He chases everyone down.
Home crowd, home noise, home win. That is the plan.
scout: Pulisic is the star — quick cuts, cool finishes.
Caruso's tackles can stop an attack dead. He hustles every play.
USA.fact: The USA is hosting the 2026 World Cup with Mexico and Canada.

UZB.name: Uzbekistan

lines.intro: First World Cup for Uzbekistan. The White Wolves are hungry.
lines.win: The wolves feast! All of Tashkent is dancing.
lines.lose: Wolves learn from every hunt. We are learning fast.

taunt: Nobody dribbles past Khusanov. Nobody.
New to the World Cup. Not new to winning.
The White Wolves hunt as a pack. You face all of us.
scout: Khusanov is the rock in defence — fast and fearless.
Shomurodov leads the line and takes the big chances.
UZB.fact: This is Uzbekistan's first ever World Cup.
